name: JW Marriott Panama
insider_take: This gleaming tower stands as Panama City's most prestigious address, where the cosmopolitan energy of Central America's financial hub meets world-class luxury.
whats_special: The JW Marriott Panama occupies the top floors of the Trump Ocean Club, offering unparalleled panoramic views of both the Pacific Ocean and Panama City's dramatic skyline. As the tallest building in Latin America, this architectural marvel features a distinctive sail-shaped design that has become an iconic part of the city's silhouette. The hotel's location in the exclusive Punta Pacifica district puts you steps away from the Multiplaza Pacific mall and minutes from the historic Casco Viejo.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 50+ for breathtaking sunset views over the Pacific, and time your arrival to coincide with the daily ship parade through the nearby Panama Canal.
dont_miss: The hotel's infinity pool on the 15th floor offers Instagram-worthy city views, while the Sortis Spa provides treatments inspired by indigenous Panamanian traditions. The nearby Biomuseo, designed by Frank Gehry, tells the fascinating story of Panama's role in connecting continents and separating oceans.
pros: Prime location in Panama City's financial district
Luxury amenities including spa and multiple dining venues
Modern accommodations with city and ocean views
Excellent business facilities and meeting spaces
cons: Urban location may lack beach access
Premium pricing typical of luxury chain hotels
